correctness.rationale: Direct script enumerates all 2**16 16-bit subsets using exact closed-ball signatures and proves min size 7, 960 optima, 4320 undirected one-token exchanges, regular degree 9, connectivity and the exact 8-bin BFS histogram at each of all 960 starts. Independent script uses tuple-of-sensor-index signatures, combination enumeration, alternate set replacement and cube-group symmetry to confirm three 192/384/384 orbits and the same BFS shell at each orbit representative. Every finite range and adjacency is exhaustive; no extrapolation to other dimensions.

value.rationale: These are intrinsically motivated replacement distances among all optimal radius-one sensor-identification placements on a classical hypercube, not a new code size alone. The exact 9-regular reconfiguration degree, 7-move global diameter and complete uniform shell profile measure the resilience and accessibility of optimal solutions; three cube-automorphism orbits sharing one metric profile is additional nontrivial geometry. No broad general theorem is claimed.
